_help: The main story's own clock, by act. It's empty since 2026-11-12, when the written main story was taken out of the game: nothing happens by act, and the story stays in act 1.

To give a story of your own a clock by act, put the acts in the list below, the first for act 1: { "events": [{ "after": 7, "news": "What people hear.", "fleet": { "morale": -1 } }], "moves_on": { "after": 45, "news": "What people hear when the act ends by itself." } }. after is how many days into the act, give or take a fifth; fleet is what changes aboard the Meridian (morale, food, medicine, parts, fuel); moves_on moves the story on to the next act if nobody has by then.
Each story's own clock is in its file in world/stories, under If nobody steps in and Consequences.
